options.label: React + Tailwind SPA
options.promptModifier: Build a client-side single-page application using React, Tailwind CSS, and local storage state management.

options.label: Next.js + Firebase App
options.promptModifier: Build a full-stack Next.js web application integrated with Firebase Authentication, Firestore, and Tailwind styling.

options.label: Chrome Extension (Manifest V3)
options.promptModifier: Build a Manifest V3 Chrome Extension with background service worker, side panel UI, content script DOM injection, and chrome.storage.local persistence.

options.label: Production-Ready & Modular
options.promptModifier: Write modular, fully typed, well-commented, production-ready clean code following SOLID design principles and robust error handling.

options.label: Defensive & Validated
options.promptModifier: Include defensive checks, complete input validations, error boundaries, and zero unhandled exception side-effects.

options.label: Modern Dark Mode UI
options.promptModifier: Design a slick, modern dark mode interface with subtle gradient borders, crisp typography, and interactive micro-animations.

options.label: Clean Dashboard Layout
options.promptModifier: Create an intuitive dashboard layout with tabbed navigation, responsive grid cards, and clear visual hierarchy.

options.label: Visionary & Strategic
options.promptModifier: Adopt a visionary, strategic tone focusing on high-level feature conceptualization, long-term scalability, and user impact.

options.label: Analytical & Structured
options.promptModifier: Provide an analytical breakdown with structured feature hierarchies, edge-case evaluation, and trade-off comparisons.

options.label: First Principles Breakdown
options.promptModifier: Break down core user pain points from first principles and map out step-by-step product capabilities to address them.

options.label: Phased Feature Roadmap
options.promptModifier: Structure recommendations into Phase 1 (MVP core), Phase 2 (Growth & Automation), and Phase 3 (Advanced Ecosystem Integration).

options.label: Dynamic Action Scene
options.promptModifier: Dynamic wide-angle action pose interacting with high-tech environment elements.

options.label: Heroic Studio Portrait
options.promptModifier: Centered medium-up studio character portrait with clean background depth of field.

options.label: Isometric 3D Workspace
options.promptModifier: Clean 3D isometric perspective showcasing character working inside a futuristic software lab.

options.label: Cyberpunk Neon Glow
options.promptModifier: Vibrant cyan and magenta rim lighting with high-contrast ambient neon shadows.

options.label: Soft Studio Lighting
options.promptModifier: Soft diffused studio lighting with gentle key light reflection and subtle rim highlight.

options.label: Vibrant Vector Palette
options.promptModifier: Bright vibrant primary color palette with bold vector outlines and high visual clarity.

options.label: Soft Pastel Tech
options.promptModifier: Clean modern pastel color scheme with clean white and soft blue accent highlights.
